title: Koji-Glazed Australian Sausage with Fennel
description: A modern take on traditional Japanese flavors, this dish features a sweet and savory glaze made with koji.

ingredients.name: Australian sausage
ingredients.notes: Look for Japanese-style sausage or substitute with a similar variety

ingredients.name: Fennel
ingredients.notes: Thinly slice or chop for better flavor

ingredients.name: Koji
ingredients.notes: You can also use miso paste as a substitute

ingredients.name: Shio
ingredients.notes: Japanese salt, or substitute with kosher salt

ingredients.name: Fennel seeds
ingredients.notes: Optional, but adds a nice anise flavor

instructions: 2. In a small saucepan, combine koji, shio, and fennel seeds. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture turns golden brown.
3. Add 1 tablespoon of water to the saucepan and bring to a simmer.
4. Meanwhile, cook the Australian sausage in a pan over medium-high heat, until browned on all sides.
5. Transfer the sausage to a baking dish and brush with the koji glaze.
6. Roast in the oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the glaze is caramelized and the sausage is cooked through.
7. Serve with sliced fennel and your choice of sides.
